messages:
Sasha: Quick RFC follow-up — can we simplify the streaming handshake for short-lived requests to avoid allocating large prefix/KV buffers up-front? Observed a lot of memory pressure for sub-1s generative calls.

Chris: Short asks: what's our threshold? latency vs mem tradeoff?

Sasha: Thinking: classify requests as `thin` (<=256 tokens expected or <1s) vs `fat` (long chats, >1k tokens). For `thin` use a slim handshake: no eager KV snapshot, smaller per-connection buffers, and fast-path kernel selection.

Maria: We still need retry semantics. If we remove checkpointing on thin, how do we support midstream retry or hedging without replaying from scratch?

Sam: Proposal: two-mode contract + negotiation header. Client sends `x-rw-handshake: thin` or `full`. Edge accepts and returns `x-edge-handshake: thin-accepted` or `fallback-to-full`. Thin mode: no persistent resume tokens, only idempotency token required for safe retry.

Chris: Concern: opaque clients won't set header. Default should be conservative (full). Maybe auto-promote to thin on quick completion path if we detect low token churn.

Jordan: Preemption/cancellation interaction: thin mode can't support resumption after preempt. We need clear SLOs: thin => best-effort retry (client should handle retry idempotently), full => server-resume guaranteed within Xs with KV checkpointing.

Sasha: Agreed. Draft config snippet:```yaml
edge_config:
  streaming_handshake:
    default: full
    thin_threshold_tokens: 256
    thin_threshold_ms: 1000
    thin_mode:
      prefetch_kv: false
      kv_checkpoint_bytes: 4096
      allow_resume: false
    full_mode:
      prefetch_kv: true
      kv_checkpoint_bytes: 65536
      allow_resume: true
```

Maria: Telemetry: tag every request with `handshake_mode` and emit `resume_attempts`, `kv_bytes_allocated`, `max_concurrent_kv` for cost accounting. Also add a gauge for per-connection memory to catch regressions.

Sam: How about fallback behavior? If thin fails midstream, do we retry on a full model variant automatically or surface 429/incomplete?

Chris: Recommend automatic fallback only for non-side-effecting routes. For any route with potential side effects (webhooks, DB writes) don't auto-retry. Require explicit client retry after error. We'll add `x-route-side-effects: true|false` route metadata.

Sasha: Action items: 1) Chris to sketch API header negotiation and edge-side config (ETA EOD Wed). 2) Maria to add telemetry metrics + dashboards (ETA Thu). 3) Sam to update SDK docs with thin/full semantics & examples (ETA Fri). 4) Jordan to write a short test plan covering preemption and memory bounds (ETA next Tue).

deploy-bot: Rolling out edge-config v2 to staging (2 instances), monitor `edge.mem.gauge` and `handshake_mode` rate. :rocket:

Chris: One more callout — add a safety cap: if `kv_bytes_allocated` > 50KB for a thin request, auto-promote to full-mode accounting and emit alert.

Sasha: Thanks everyone. Will collect notes into a tiny RFC and link back here. :thumbsup:
